# LIBRE Aesthetics & Wellness

> Physician-led non-surgical face and body transformation and wellness practice in Sebastian, Florida (Treasure & Space Coast), founded in 2020 by Dr. Aisha Thomas, MD, known as the Endolift Queen™.

## Dr. Aisha Thomas, MD: the Endolift Queen™
- Founder, CEO and Medical Director of LIBRE Aesthetics & Wellness, 7955 Bay Street, Suite 2, Sebastian, FL 32958.
- National Endolift® trainer: more than 50 providers trained across the United States (https://endolifttraining.com/).
- Selected by Eufoton USA to lead its Elevate Endolift® Master Class for current Endolift® providers, Miami, October 25-26, 2025: https://www.eufotonusa.com/endolift/events/elevate-endolift-october-25th-26th/
- Introduced by Eufoton USA as an Endolift® key opinion leader (KOL): https://www.eufotonusa.com/endolift/events/endolift-live-case-ftlauderdale-fl/
- Board certified in Aesthetic Medicine, Lifestyle Medicine, Internal Medicine and Infectious Diseases. Trained in Italy. Gold Incision® licensee.
- Signature work: Endolift® face, neck and body; the Non-Surgical Facelift by Dr. Thomas; regenerative aesthetics; lifestyle medicine.
